evidence: A baseline TinyModel process starts successfully under spawn, but after dispatch_model(model, {"": "cpu"}) the parent fails during p.start() with _pickle.PicklingError: Can't pickle <function Embedding.forward ...>: it's not the same object as torch.nn.modules.sparse.Embedding.forward.
steps: Create a tiny nn.Module with Embedding and Linear layers.
Start a multiprocessing.Process with the spawn start method using the undecorated model; the child starts successfully.
Run accelerate.big_modeling.dispatch_model(model, {"": "cpu"}) and pass the wrapped model to multiprocessing.Process; p.start() raises PicklingError.
